# Anton Merkurov — Official Platform & Archive

> Media expert, publicist, artist, and art dealer. Regular columnist for Novaya Gazeta ("Virtual Merkurov"). Great-grandson of Soviet sculptor Sergey Merkurov. Operating at the intersection of high-tech, digital heritage, and context architecture.

## Core Ecosystem & Projects
- [UNFRAMED](https://www.merkurov.love/unframed/book): Memoir and essays on digital legacy, network autonomy, and personal sovereignty.
- [Flow](https://www.merkurov.love/flow): Custom publishing feed, stream of columns, and curated notes.
- [Heart & Angel](https://www.merkurov.love/heartandangel): Multidisciplinary art project exploring archetypal figures through painting, augmented reality, and Web3 smart contracts.
- [Digital Temple](https://www.merkurov.love/temple): Immersive digital sanctuary, live whispers, absolution rituals, and verified thoughts (/temple, /vigil, /absolution, /tribute).
- [The Private Office / Advisory](https://www.merkurov.love/advising): Heritage architecture, art advisory, and digital sovereignty for private clients.
- [Curators Engine](https://www.merkurov.love/curators): Fine art auction parser and market analytics engine.

## Identity & Background
- Media expert, columnist, and former vice president of the Association of Internet Publishers.
- Preserving and promoting the cultural heritage of monumental sculptor Sergey Merkurov and the Sergey Merkurov Museum-House in Gyumri.

## Technical Architecture
- Framework: Next.js (App Router), React, TypeScript
- Database & Auth: Supabase, PostgreSQL, Prisma
- Styling: Tailwind CSS
- Infrastructure: Vercel, Hostinger, GitHub Codespaces
